title: Statistical Quantum Phase Estimation: Extensions and Practical Considerations
summary: We present several refinements and extensions of the statistical quantum phase estimation (SQPE) framework to address some of its key practical limitations, improving its applicability to realistic cases. Recently, a family of statistical approaches for QPE have been proposed where each run uses only a few ancillae and shorter circuits than standard QPE and thus is better suited for early fault-tolerant quantum computers that are qubit-and depth-limited.
